newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IBCA reaffirms Dorbyl domestic ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA reaffirms Dorbyl domestic ratings.

text.p: Rating agency IBCA on Wednesday reaffirmed engineering firm Dorbyl Ltd's domestic "A1" short-term and "A" long-term ratings.
It said the ratings reflected the low expectation of investment risk arising from long-term obligations.
"The capacity for timely repayment of principal and interest is strong, although adverse changes in business, economic or financial conditions could lead to increased investment risk," IBCA said.
Short-term obligations were supported by the highest capacity for timely repayment, it said.
